messages:
anna: quick heads-up — periodic access review flagged 3 principals with admin/KMS grants that reference other AWS accounts. not sure who granted cross-account decrypt rights.

mike: can you paste the IAM snippet? we need to know whether it's `kms:Decrypt` in the key policy or an IAM grant.

anna: here's the key policy excerpt we pulled: 

```\n{\n  \"Sid\": \"AllowCrossAccountAdmin\",\n  \"Effect\": \"Allow\",\n  \"Principal\": {\"AWS\": \"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/partner-admin\"},\n  \"Action\": [\"kms:Encrypt\",\"kms:Decrypt\",\"kms:ReEncrypt*\",\"kms:GenerateDataKey*\"],\n  \"Resource\": \"*\"\n}\n```\n
lisa: yikes. that's pretty broad. if partner-admin shouldn't have those, we must remove or narrow.

jess: do we have audit logs showing usage? if no usage in 90 days -> remove. SRE should run a CloudTrail query to confirm.

mike: i'll kick off the query: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234 --start-time 2024-09-01` — will post results when done.

audit-bot: automated note — scheduled least-privilege sweep job created (job id lp-sweep-20260320). no immediate changes applied.

anna: decision proposal: (1) run usage query, (2) reach out to owning team for justification, (3) if no justification or no recent usage, remove admin-level actions and replace with a scoped grant (Encrypt/Decrypt limited to allowed aliases + explicit principals). any objections?

lisa: +1. also add kms grant rotation check and annotate in the access-review ticket.

jess: i'll draft the minimal policy and open a PR in `infra/iam` with test plan and rollback steps. i'll include policy snippet and `terraform plan` output.

mike: results posted — 0 decrypt events in last 180 days for that key. tagging thread `needs-owner` and `remediation`.

anna: cool. create the access-review ticket with remediation checklist and assign to jess for PR and to SRE for post-change monitoring. timeline: remove in 72h if owner doesn't respond.

jess: ack — opening ticket + PR today. will include the cloudtrail query results and add a short-lived alert (SCC) to catch any unexpected decrypts for 30 days post-change.

mike: also documented `kms:GrantToken` removal in the playbook — partner roles sometimes use grants that bypass normal key policy checks.

anna: thanks team. follow-ups will live in the ticket. :thumbsup:
